people.name: Barnabas
people.line: A Levite from Cyprus who accompanied Paul on missionary journeys.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Titus
people.line: Gentile convert and companion of Paul

translations.web: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.
translations.bsb: Fourteen years later I went up again to Jerusalem, accompanied by Barnabas. I took Titus along also.
translations.kjv: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.
translations.asv: Then after the space of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.
